decision.reasoning_trace: I selected the Polar Vantage V2 - Premium Multisport Smartwatch with GPS as the final choice because it has a high rating of 4.3, a large number of reviews (1038), and is from a known brand (Polar). The consideration set includes a mix of high-end smartwatches from reputable brands (Garmin, Apple, Polar) and some more affordable options, but the Polar Vantage V2 stands out for its premium features and strong customer feedback.
